feedback:
Approved because this is the last action run this iteration. A revise would need a review, a revision and then a race, and only one run remains, so approving is the only way to get a scored race.

The candidate changes only the controller from the iteration 2 best (score 422.3): kp 3.5 to 3.0 and kd 0.6 to 0.8. base_speed 1.2, geometry and sensor_weights are unchanged. The evidence is iteration 2's per-track metrics. max_error was 0.0612 on the s-bend and 0.0631 on the slalom, both at or above the 0.06 m limit, while the oval was 0.034. rms_error stayed low (0.010 to 0.019), so the failures are edge excursions on bends, not poor average tracking. steering_oscillation was 0.27, 0.32 and 0.25, all above 0.2 with kd 0.6. The two conditional rules from the earlier Evaluator feedback therefore both apply: lower kp toward 3.0 and raise kd toward 0.8. Nothing here predicts how the candidate will perform; the race will show it.

What to do with the telemetry, if a later iteration is available. If max_error is still at or above 0.06 on the s-bend or slalom, test a sensor-geometry change (wider sensor spread, for example x of about plus or minus 0.03) or a small base_speed reduction to 1.1. If completion_time on the oval rises above 2.5 s, hold base_speed and do not raise it. If steering_oscillation falls clearly while completion stays up, damping is working and speed is the next lever.
requested_changes: If max_error on the s-bend or slalom is still at or above 0.06 with kp 3.0 and kd 0.8, change controller.base_speed from 1.2 to 1.1 to test whether speed is the limit, since iteration 2 max_error was 0.0612 and 0.0631 at base_speed 1.2.

If completion_time on the oval rises above 2.5 s after the kp and kd change, hold controller.base_speed at 1.2 rather than raising it, because the oval finished in about 2.06 s in iteration 2 and speed is not the constraint there.

If steering_oscillation stays above 0.2 with kd 0.8, or the slalom still ends off track, try a sensor-geometry change such as a wider sensor spread (x near plus or minus 0.03 m), since iteration 2 steering_oscillation was 0.25 to 0.32 and the sensor spread has not been tested.
